nodes.label: ADR 0001: Direct Charges on Stripe Connect for Customer→Tenant Payments
nodes.contributor: rationale: Direct charges chosen so statement descriptor matches Tenant brand, dispute/refund burden stays with Tenant, GST liability stays with Tenant. Destination charges and separate-charges+transfers rejected because they make Avantej merchant of record for services it does not operate.

nodes.label: Two Payment Layers: Layer 1 (Tenant→Avantej SaaS), Layer 2 (Customer→Tenant Connect)
